text: かつと　しょうきんが　もらえ　ポケモンも　つよく　なっていく！

structure.jp: しょうきんが　もらえ
structure.en: you can get prize money, and

structure.jp: ポケモンも　つよく　なっていく！
structure.en: your Pokémon keep getting stronger too!

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever this happens, the next thing always follows. かつと = 'if you win'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says the change keeps going on from now. つよく　なっていく = 'go on getting stronger'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing もらう to もらえる gives 'can get'; here it is cut short to もらえ to join on to the next part like 'and'. しょうきんが　もらえ = 'you can get prize money, and'.
